Renderer
Graphics, start and sound
Glide
D2GL on the GPU, full screen. Recommended.
DirectDraw
The game\'s own renderer through Wine. For when Glide does not start.
Game resolution

The size the game draws at, also for the official PD2 launcher and a game it starts. The game\'s own size shows the game as PD2 made it. Its graphics options are in the game: Options, Video Options, D2GL.
The game or the official launcher that runs now has another size. The new size applies when you start it again.
Game\'s own size (%1$d × %2$d)
The size PD2 was made for. Recommended.
The full size of this screen, which is smaller than the size PD2 was made for.
Custom (%1$d × %2$d)
Custom…
A width and a height that you type, up to the size of this screen.
Width
Height
Width from %1$d to %3$d, an even number. Height from %2$d to %4$d, a multiple of 4.
The official PD2 launcher does not get smaller than 800 × 600. At a smaller size, part of its window is cut off.
This size is not possible. Width from %1$d to %3$d, an even number. Height from %2$d to %4$d, a multiple of 4.
Display
How the game and the official PD2 launcher show on the screen. A change applies at once, also while they run. It is also in the in-game menu.
Fit to screen
What the game shows, its menus and the official launcher too, is as large as the screen allows. Its shape stays the same.
Center
Each game pixel is one screen pixel, in the middle of the screen, with black around it. Sharp, but smaller. If the game resolution is larger than the screen, Fit to screen applies.
%1$d × %2$d (full)
Graphics profile
D2GL\'s settings for the game\'s look, written at the next Play. What you change in the game (Options, Video Options, D2GL) stays until you pick another profile.
Automatic: Default
Automatic: Performance
Performance on older or entry-level Adreno GPUs and on Mali GPUs, Default on newer Adrenos.
Default
Project Diablo 2\'s own D2GL settings.
Performance
D2GL\'s advanced settings tuned down for older devices: a simpler shader, no sharpening, no bloom.
Frame rate
Fewer frames a second use less battery and keep the device cooler, but the game moves less smoothly. This applies while vsync is on in the game\'s own options (the game\'s default).
fps
%1$d–%2$d fps. This screen shows at most %2$d.
Type a whole number from %1$d to %2$d.
OK
Cancel
Slower game in the background

While you do not see the game (another app in front, the screen off, or these settings open), the app tells the game. The game then uses its own Max Background FPS setting (in the game: Options, Video Options, D2GL, Advanced Options, Screen). This saves battery.
Skip to Battle.net
The game opens on the online screen.
Sound in background
The game keeps its sound when another app is in front.
Game updates
Check for game updates

Before the game starts, Play checks for a new version of Project Diablo 2. When this setting is off, Play starts the game with no update, for example with a mod or an older version. An import keeps its Project Diablo 2 as it is.
Screen
Keep the screen on during play
The screen does not dim or turn off while the game shows.
Show fps
A small counter in a corner of the game: the frames the game draws each second.
Android
Battery optimisation
On. Android may pause downloads and installs while the screen is off. Choose \"Not optimised\" for PD2 Launcher in the list that opens.
Off for PD2 Launcher. Work goes on in the background.
Battery settings
Notifications
Off. Android may stop the game while PD2 Launcher is in the background.
On. The session notification keeps the Launcher and the game running.

Diablo II source

Download
